description:
Composition & Indication

Metformin 850mg — 60 Tablets (Generic for Glucophage®) contains Metformin Hydrochloride 850 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 60 Tablets at the official 850mg strength. The standard indication is the management of type 2 diabetes management, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Metformin 850mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use. Authentic product sourced from licensed Mexican distributors. Same-day delivery to Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the Los Cabos tourist corridor. Bilingual customer support available 24/7 for visitors and residents.
